Moving wall-stage reports cover the full benchmark; guarded CPU uses a smaller window. Overlapping stages are not summed.
Budget and LOD span summaries and counters cover the whole record, including loading; final gauges and pending counts are endpoint snapshots.

Draw instrumentation adds overhead. No count-capture FPS is used as matched timing evidence.

All expected standard/extended mesh variants are wrapped, but three transparent variants and non-mesh render nodes are outside the count coverage. Argument slots include zero-instance records, not actual GPU-visible draws.
Historical allocated indirect records are capacity observations and are not compared to current issued slots as if they were the same measure.
The requested 10-second draw-clock crop includes a warmup tail and is independent of the main benchmark frame/time clock. Counts are identical in every selected schedule.
GPU timestamp support is reported by hardware, but sampled Bevy GPU values are all zero and unavailable as performance evidence.
Moving validation remains counter-only. Static manual PNG review proves the recorded screenshot, not every view or frame.
